_about: Copy to ~/.config/anotherme/config.json and keep only the settings you want. Every one is optional.
_telegram_dir: Where your Telegram login is kept. `python3 context/server.py telegram-login` makes one in the default place.
_projects_dir: Where jobs find a project by its folder name.
_local_model: Run every model call on a model on this Mac instead of Claude (docs/models.md). Delete this setting to use Claude.
